intro.zeile1: The city has REHWEI, the weekly market, the GOOBYTHEKE — but no place to eat with your paws at 6 pm.
intro.zeile2: An empty corner lot, a construction sign, a dream: two golden arches that, on closer inspection, look like spoons with ears.
intro.zeile3: Today is the trial shift! The grill is hot, the order bell is polished — and the first customers are hungry.

angebot.text: The construction sign is down, the spoon arches are glowing: this joint can be YOURS — with a fryer, a drinks tap and a little stage for really big performances.
angebot.frage: Tie on the apron for good?
angebot.zu_wenig: Not enough coins yet — luckily every trial shift pays out a few! ({preis} needed)
angebot.gate: Buying unlocks at level {level} — you are level {aktuell}. The trial shift stays open, of course!

schicht.hilfe: Tap the patty as soon as it glows golden brown — inside the golden window you get a “Perfect!”. Too late is never a loss: it simply becomes a Roast Aroma Special worth half the points.
schicht.hilfe_voll: Grill: tap inside the golden window. Fryer: hold the basket and release inside the golden window — then salt it, quick! Drinks tap: hold and set the cup down in time, big cups take patience. Too late is never a loss — it simply becomes a Roast Aroma Special.

ende.untertitel: Gooby flips the sign to CLOSED — the spoon arches light up.
ende.angebot_hinweis: Shift done! This joint could be YOURS …
